verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a payments SaaS product with a Dashboard, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server serves external AI agents, and Smart Disputes is an automation feature; both are adjacent capabilities that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
